Metadata.title: Word Bank — AI Vocabulary & Reading
Metadata.description: AI instantly fills in word meanings and example sentences, and reading content plus Leitner review help you master them completely. Supports 14 languages.

hero.subtitleLine1: Found a word you don't know? Just save it.
hero.subtitleLine2: AI instantly finds the meaning, examples, and synonyms for you.

read.title: Meet words as you read
read.desc: Practice reading with AI-generated stories in 10 languages across 6 levels. Tap any unfamiliar word to see its meaning instantly.

save.title: Save with one tap, AI fills in the rest
save.desc: Whether you found it while reading or typed it yourself, just save it. AI instantly finds the part of speech, meaning, pronunciation, example sentences, synonyms, and antonyms.

organize.title: Organize it your way
organize.desc: Organize your vocabulary by language or by categories you create. Assign colors, search freely, and export to Excel whenever you need.

review.title: Review right before you forget
review.desc: The 5-box Leitner system spaces out words you know and reviews unfamiliar ones more often. Choose from three modes: flip cards, fill in the blank, or listen and answer.

reminder.title: Review reminders
reminder.desc: Get review reminders at the time you want, scoped to the language, category, or mode you choose.

quickAdd.title: Quick add from notifications
quickAdd.desc: Found a word in another app? Add it right from the notification shade.

export.title: Excel export
export.desc: Export your saved vocabulary to an .xlsx file and use it however you like.

darkMode.title: Dark mode
darkMode.desc: Supports light, dark, and system themes.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: Word Bank (the "App") values your privacy. This policy explains what information the App collects, how it is used, and how it is protected.

collect.heading: Information We Collect
collect.highlight: Word Bank does not collect personally identifiable information. No sign-up, email, or name is required to use the app.
items: Learning progress data — Review progress, Leitner box state, and other learning data are stored only in local storage on your device.

App settings — Most settings, such as theme and review reminder times, are stored only on your device. The exception is your learning language, which is also synced to our server when you use the "Expression Recommendation Notifications" feature (see below).

Push notification token and learning language (optional feature) — If you enable "Expression Recommendation Notifications" in Settings, your device's push notification token, learning language, and time zone are stored in Google Firebase and linked to your anonymous user identifier so notifications can be delivered. This data is used only for notification delivery, and turning the feature off deletes the stored token.
Anonymous user identifier — The app uses Google Firebase Anonymous Authentication. A randomly generated anonymous ID is issued without sign-up and is not linked to a specific individual.

Usage analytics — Events for key in-app actions (screen views, adding words, completing study sessions, reading stories, etc.) are sent to Google Analytics for Firebase to help improve the service. Events include only statistical information such as language codes and study mode — never word content or personally identifying information.

Word search queries — When you look up a meaning or example, your search term is passed through the app's own server (Firebase Cloud Functions) to the Google Gemini API for processing. No user identifier is included, and the request is handled anonymously.

AI-generated word data — AI-generated meanings, examples, phonetics (IPA), synonyms, and antonyms are cached in Google Firebase. This is a shared cache used to speed up repeat lookups of the same word, and it is de-identified data not linked to any specific user.

Word correction feedback — If you report or request a correction to a word's content (meaning, examples, synonyms, etc.), the word and your feedback are stored in Google Firebase. Stored feedback may be periodically aggregated and used for AI analysis to improve service quality. It does not include your name, email, or other personally identifying information.

Error reports — When the app crashes or encounters an error, device information (OS version, app version, where the error occurred) is sent to Sentry's servers. Depending on the error, the word or sentence text you were entering at the time may also be included.

Subscription information (Premium subscribers) — Payments are processed by Google Play, and the app never receives card numbers or other payment details. To check your subscription status, your anonymous user identifier and purchase information (product, purchase/renewal/expiry dates, purchase token, etc.) are stored with RevenueCat and Google Firebase.

permissions.heading: App Permissions
permissions.intro: The app uses the following permissions. It does not use sensitive permissions such as camera, location, contacts, or microphone.
items: INTERNET — Looking up word meanings and displaying ads
POST_NOTIFICATIONS — Showing review reminders
RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED — Restoring notification schedules after a device restart
VIBRATE — Notification vibration

thirdParty.heading: Third-Party Services
thirdParty.intro: The app uses the following third-party services, each governed by its own privacy policy.

services.name: Google Gemini API
services.purpose: Generating word meanings and examples (relayed through our own server)

services.name: Google Firebase
services.purpose: Anonymous authentication, word cache storage, correction feedback storage, usage analytics, push notification delivery

services.name: Sentry
services.purpose: App error collection and stability improvement

services.name: RevenueCat
services.purpose: Verifying subscription purchases and managing subscription status

ads.heading: Advertising
ads.body: The app displays banner and rewarded ads through Google AdMob. Ads are served as non-personalized only. AdMob may use an advertising identifier to serve ads.
ads.androidNote: Android: Settings → Google → Ads → Delete advertising ID or opt out of ad personalization

children.heading: Children's Privacy
children.body: The app is not directed at children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe a child under 13 is using the app, please contact us immediately at the email below.

retention.heading: Data Retention and Deletion
retention.body: Local data on your device is deleted when you delete the app. Cached data stored in Firebase is de-identified and is not linked to any specific user. Subscription information is kept for as long as needed to manage your subscription and to meet legal record-keeping obligations.

changes.heading: Changes to This Policy
changes.body: This privacy policy may change over time. Any changes will be reflected by updating the "Last updated" date on this page.

contact.heading: Contact
contact.prefix: If you have any questions about how your information is handled, please contact us at:

Terms.title: Terms of Service
Terms.intro: These Terms govern your use of the Word Bank app (the "App") provided by Talaria (the "Operator"). By installing or using the App, you agree to these Terms.

sections.heading: About the Service
paragraphs: The App is a vocabulary service for language learners. When you enter a word or select a sentence in a story, AI organizes its meanings, examples and part of speech into your wordbook, and you can review with flashcards and spaced repetition.

sections.heading: Accounts
paragraphs: You can use the App without signing up. On first launch the App creates an anonymous identifier for your device, which is used to manage usage limits and subscription status.
If you uninstall the App or change devices, a new anonymous identifier is created. You can recover an active subscription with Restore Purchases, described under 'Premium Subscription'.

sections.heading: Free Use and Usage Limits
items: Free users can add up to 5 words a day with AI.
Watching an ad grants additional additions.
The daily limit resets every day at 00:00 UTC.
Use beyond normal learning, such as bulk requests with automated tools, may be restricted.

sections.heading: Premium Subscription
paragraphs: With a Premium subscription you can use the App without ads and add up to 100 words a day with AI. The 100-word daily limit exists to keep the service stable and fair for everyone.
items: Payment is charged to your Google Play account. The price and billing period (monthly or yearly) are shown on the purchase screen.
Your subscription renews automatically on the same terms and you are charged for renewal unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.

You can cancel in the Google Play app under 'Payments & subscriptions', or from 'Manage subscription' in the App's settings. After cancelling, you keep your benefits until the end of the period you've paid for.
If a free trial is offered, it converts to a paid subscription automatically unless you cancel before the trial ends.
If the subscription price changes, you will be notified in advance and asked for consent where required, following Google Play's process.
If you reinstall the App or change devices, use 'Restore purchases' in the App's settings with the same Google account to recover your subscription.

sections.heading: Cancellation Rights and Refunds
paragraphs: You may withdraw from a purchase to the extent permitted by applicable law, including consumer protection laws in your country. This right may be limited where the law allows, for example once the supply of digital content has begun.
Refunds are handled by Google Play under Google Play's refund policy. You can also contact us about refunds at the address below.

sections.heading: Minors
paragraphs: If a minor purchases a subscription without the consent of a parent or legal guardian, the minor or the guardian may cancel it as provided by applicable law.

sections.heading: AI-Generated Content
paragraphs: Meanings, examples and parts of speech in the App are generated automatically by AI and may be wrong or inaccurate. Use them as learning aids only, and check a dictionary or other source where accuracy matters, such as exams or work. You can report incorrect content with the App's correction feature.

sections.heading: Data Storage and Backups
paragraphs: Your wordbook, categories, study history and settings are stored only on your device. If you uninstall the App, clear its data or change devices, this data cannot be recovered.
Please back up important wordbooks regularly with 'Export to Excel' in the App's settings. The Operator is not responsible for the loss of data stored on your device.

sections.heading: Prohibited Conduct
items: Reverse engineering or tampering with the App or its servers, or accessing them by abnormal means
Attempting to bypass usage limits or payment
Placing excessive load on the service with automated tools
Copying, distributing or commercially using the App's content (stories, illustrations, etc.) without the Operator's permission

sections.heading: Intellectual Property
paragraphs: The App and the stories, illustrations and designs it provides belong to the Operator or their rightful owners. The words and notes you save in your wordbook belong to you.

sections.heading: Ads and Third-Party Services
paragraphs: The App uses Google Play (payments), Google Firebase (authentication, database, analytics), RevenueCat (subscription management), Google AdMob (ads), the Google Gemini API (AI content generation) and Sentry (error reporting). Their own terms and policies may also apply to your use of them. See our Privacy Policy for details on how personal information is handled.

sections.heading: Changes to or Discontinuation of the Service
paragraphs: The Operator may add, change or remove features to improve the service. For significant changes that disadvantage paying subscribers, or if the service is discontinued, we will give advance notice in the App or on this website and handle it according to applicable law and Google Play policy.

sections.heading: Limitation of Liability
paragraphs: The Operator strives to provide the service reliably but is not liable for damages caused by events beyond its control, such as natural disasters, network outages or failures of third-party services. Damages caused by the Operator's intent or gross negligence are governed by applicable law.

sections.heading: Changes to These Terms
paragraphs: The Operator may change these Terms where necessary, within the limits of applicable law. Changes will be posted on this page with their effective date, and changes that disadvantage users will be announced at least 30 days in advance.

sections.heading: Governing Law and Disputes
